_comment: Example client-mimic config. Copy to ~/.pi/agent/client-mimic.config.json and edit. The live file is NOT tracked by git (it may hold environment-specific values); this example is. Missing/unknown fields are backfilled from built-in defaults on load, so you only need to keep what you change.

systemPrompt._comment: Global default when a profile's systemPrompt.mode is 'inherit'. mode: off | neutral. 'neutral' applies the kun/π identity rewrite while keeping pi's generated tools/guidelines/skills/context.

_wrapProviders_comment: Provider ids (from models.json) whose streamSimple should be wrapped at the provider level so Claude-Code body patches (metadata.user_id, billing/identity system preamble, and the thinking+output_config identity pair) also apply on code paths that bypass before_provider_request — chiefly context compaction, which calls the provider streamSimple directly without an onPayload. Only active when a Claude-Code-shaped profile (ensureMetadataUserId/prependBillingSystem) is effective. Empty array = disabled. Example: ["custom-jcp-966112-xyz-cc"]

systemPrompt._comment: Example: present a Codex-style prompt for this profile. Path is relative to ~/.pi/agent, so this resolves to the git-tracked seed file that restores with the repo. apply: replace | prepend | append.

codex-lite._comment: Use for Codex models whose metadata enables Responses Lite, such as gpt-5.6-sol. The built-in profile performs the body conversion; only prompt behavior is overridden here.
